notes: Select 2025 or 2026 in the combined federal calculation. It combines supported income, deductions, credits and additional federal taxes; specialist worksheets retain the tax year stated in their controls.

QBI supports a verified deduction or one-business calculation. EITC supports a verified amount or a continuous planning estimate that can differ from the IRS income-bin table. The child-credit calculation includes the three-or-more-child payroll alternative with its stated inputs.

Eligibility and worksheet-specific modified income must be confirmed. Enter AMT and unsupported special-return amounts separately, and exclude any amount already calculated here from other deductions or credits.
State/local comparisons use your own flat-rate assumptions and tax base. Federal bracket arithmetic can differ from tax-table rounding; these scenarios do not prepare or file a return.

notes: The annual cash estimate supports 2025 and 2026 federal planning. Its three earned-income entries belong to one taxpayer and share the selected employee or self-employed treatment; joint filing assumes no earned income for the spouse.

Employee deductions affect federal and FICA wage bases according to the selected treatment. Self-employed expenses and verified retirement contributions are applied once; self-employment tax remains inside the federal calculation.
The separate paycheck and W-4 worksheets use the stated 2026 withholding method for 2020-or-later W-4 forms. Annual tax liability and employer withholding can differ.

State and city taxes use entered rates and an explicit base. Investment income, net gains and full Social Security benefits count as available cash; actual cash flows and deductions should be checked against your records.

notes: Choose the ordinary-income comparison or the combined 2025/2026 federal scenarios. The combined mode compares eligible single, head-of-household or qualifying-surviving-spouse scenarios with a hypothetical joint scenario.

The combined mode recalculates supported income, Social Security taxation, deductions, dependent credits, self-employment tax, Additional Medicare and NIIT. Enter other qualified deductions and credits separately for each scenario; joint eligibility is not inferred by adding the separate amounts.

Each dependent is entered once, and each taxpayer retains a separate Social Security wage cap. Refundable credits are included in the federal difference; withholding is a payment rather than a change in liability.

Optional state/local results use separate entered rates and bases. They are shown separately from the federal difference. The comparison does not establish filing-status eligibility or a recommendation to marry.

notes: Choose an entered exchange rate, the ECB daily reference, or the broader dated-reference mode. The broader mode uses Frankfurter provider blends, a Coinbase Bitcoin spot snapshot and the SII daily UF value crossed through CLP.

notes: Calculate a payment, a vehicle-price budget, or rebate-versus-rate offers using the entered price, down payment, gross trade allowance, trade debt, taxes and fees.

The state-tax mode includes scoped 2026 guidance for all 50 states and DC. Automatic taxable-base presets are available only where the listed dealer-purchase conditions are satisfied; other cases use a verified base or quoted tax amount.
State selection does not determine a local rate. Confirm transaction eligibility, taxable fees, rebate treatment and trade allowance using the selected state’s primary sources.

Tax, fees and trade debt are counted once in the selected cash/financed treatment. Private sales, exemptions, special vehicle classes and other transactions outside the preset need separately verified tax treatment.

Compare eligible rebate and promotional-rate offers using the same vehicle price, term, down payment, trade, debt payoff and fees. The promotional offer removes the manufacturer rebate and recalculates purchase tax, or uses your separate verified tax quotes.
Use scoped 2026 state taxable-base treatment, your verified base assumptions, or separate quoted taxes for the two offers. State selection does not guess a combined local tax rate.
The comparison includes entered cash costs and loan interest. Early payoff, future resale value and the opportunity cost of cash are outside the calculation.
